title: Foundation Chain
description: Make the starting chain used for rows, scarves, dishcloths, and more.

content.summary: Learn the yarn-over motion and create even chain stitches.
content.whyItMatters: The foundation chain determines the width of many beginner projects.
steps: Start with a slip knot on the hook.
Yarn over from back to front.
Pull the yarn through the loop on the hook.
Repeat until your chain length looks even.
content.practice: Chain 15 stitches twice and compare how even they look.
commonMistakes: Making chains so tight the hook cannot pass through them later.
Twisting the chain and losing the front vs back of the stitches.
